We discovered an old book in the shelter after escaping the Key.
It was translated by a superhuman named Awaji.
He belonged to Unit 11 of Guardian's Far East Branch, which was a team of psychometers, people capable of reading the thoughts and memories of an object simply by touching it.
The thoughts contained in the book must have been in the final page.
He was saddened that all attempts to translate the page had all been abandoned, because there simply wasn't enough research or evidence on that particular language for anyone to understand it.
That final chapter consisted of four lines, which he translated as follows.
«The Mǎ o's destruction does not depend on humanity's growth, prosperity, or behavior.»
«I do not know if we have walked the right path.»
«But if an observer of this planet ever comes to judge us...»
«I can only pray we have matured well as a species―――»
According to Awaji, the "Mǎ o" is what we now call the Key (though he never explained why he translated it that way).
These four lines are an important clue regarding the "destruction".
As for what "mature" means, the author's interpretation was mistaken, so for the sake of those who later read this, we will leave that out.
We were mistaken.
What follows is my personal opinion.
The existence of this book clearly shows that a previous humanity lived in the distant past, with a completely different culture from our own.
It has always been unclear why we knew about the Key, and why Gaia and Guardian have been fighting over it for centuries.
If it was capable of wiping out all of humanity, then clearly all records of it should have been erased as well.
There should have been no way for any of us to remember the previous "destruction".
Does that mean records of it were left behind somewhere?
If so, they must have been written by a previous intelligent species.
After looking at the facilities in this shelter, it's impossible to doubt that the previous humanity was a far more advanced civilization than our own.
So there's a message we have to leave behind.
I pray 
that the next humanity 
can create better memories.

﻿On that day,
Lucia was definitely the Key.
In which case......what on Earth is the real Key?
Lucia is still suffering from the guilt of killing two hundred thousand people.
If the whole world was destroyed, billions would die.
Was the real Key......prepared to live with that when it came to this world?
......I don't know.
The only thing I can say is......the Key will come to the surface again someday.
And it will decide whether or not this world should continue to exist...
And it will bear the responsibility of that decision.
Do we humans really have the right to live on after the world ends in a thousand years?
Lucia was created as humanity's way to reach that world.
Forcing only her to bear that burden is just too cruel.
I can't help but sympathize with the Key, since it would have to bear it as well.
That's why I pray......that by the time the next Key comes,
the world will be good enough......that she won't make that decision.
